lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cr₆Ge₂ (reduced formula Cr₃Ge) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imm2 (No. 194), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Ge and Cr centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each; Ge is surrounded by 12 Cr neighbors, while Cr environments include 4 Cr and 8 Ge or 8 Cr and 4 Ge neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is fully 3-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Cr and Ge coordination polyhedra.
